android.desc:
Transform your phone into a powerful receipt scanner, expense tracker, and mileage tracker — all in one app. 
Smart Receipts helps individuals, freelancers, and business owners capture every expense, maximize every IRS deduction, and turn tax season from a headache into a few taps.

SMART RECEIPTS — YOUR ALL-IN-ONE EXPENSE SOLUTION
Whether you're managing personal finances or running a small business, Smart Receipts delivers customizable PDF, CSV, and ZIP reports built for real-world accounting. Organize expenses into "folders," categorize spending, and generate professional reports that simplify tax filings, reimbursements, and bookkeeping.

KEY FEATURES
• Powerful receipt scanner with AI-powered OCR — capture every detail in seconds
• Snap photos with your camera or import existing images
• Upload and process PDF receipts effortlessly
• Import your existing CSV files or bank statements in seconds
• Connect your bank account (USA & Canada only) to automatically pull in expenses and transactions
• Track price, tax, currency, and payment method for every purchase
• Tag entries with names, categories, comments, and custom metadata
• Built-in mileage tracker for reimbursement and IRS deduction claims
• Automatic exchange rate calculations for international travel and business trips
• Smart predictions based on past entries — faster reporting every time
• Fully customizable PDF, CSV, and ZIP reports

SAVE HOURS EVERY WEEK
Stop typing expenses into spreadsheets. Smart Receipts eliminates manual data entry by combining a fast receipt scanner, CSV import, and direct bank sync (USA/Canada). Whether you're tracking a single business trip or a year of deductions, your records stay organized and tax-ready.
BUILT FOR ACCOUNTING & BOOKKEEPING
Accountants, bookkeepers, and small business owners trust Smart Receipts to keep clients audit-ready. Export clean, IRS-friendly reports in seconds and spend less time chasing paperwork.

YOUR DATA, SECURED
Smart Receipts protects your sensitive financial information with secure automatic backups to our private cloud and AI-powered OCR for accurate scanning. Your records stay safe, organized, and accessible whenever you need them.
JOIN OVER 1,000,000 USERS
More than a million people trust Smart Receipts as their go-to expense tracker and mileage tracker. Built by a seasoned consultant, the app is designed for efficiency, flexibility, and the realities of modern financial management.

Download Smart Rec

quotes.text:
I created Smart Receipts, a receipt tracker and expense report generator for Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=wb.receipts.

I make about $600/month between ads on the free version and sales for the paid version; not enough to quit my full-time job but a nice monthly supplement.
